description.value:
_The Bear_ represents brute force applied to solve unusual problems. As long as you have _The Bear_ invested, you can use Athletics checks to Tumble Through or Squeeze.

Activate (2 Actions)
Frequency: once per minute
Requirements: Your last action was a successful melee Strike
You attempt to Grapple, Shove, or Trip the creature you hit with the successful Strike, even if you have no hand free. You gain a +2 status bonus to your check. If you Grapple using a weapon, you can Strike with the weapon only if it has the grapple trait and you Strike the grabbed target, or if you cease Grabbing with the weapon. After the effect of the initial Grapple ends, you can't keep a target grabbed with a weapon that lacks the grapple trait. The status bonus increases to +3 if you're at least 17th level.
